text.en:
Subject to the approval of the majority of the votes cast in a plebiscite to be held in the areas
affected, the barangays of Kalawang, Gastao, Paradise, Malinao, Camalig, Pinamulaan, Pantar, Busaon,
Tinimbacan, Nalagap, Salama and Banisilan of the Municipality of Carmen, Province of North Cotabato, are
hereby separated from said municipality and constituted into a distinct and independent municipality in the
same province to be known as the Municipality of Banisilan, with its seat of government in the present site of
Barangay Banisilan.

The Municipality of Banisilan shall be bounded as follows:
"The point of origin is the intersection of Malitubog River and Cotabato-Lanao del Sur province boundary,
point (1): thence following the Cotabato Lanao de Sur provincial boundary in an easterly direction to the
junction of Kalawaeg and Maridagao Rivers, a common point boundary of Cotabato-Lanao del Sur and
Bukidnon provinces, point (2); thence southerly following the Maridagao river downstream to its junction
with Tumagak point (3), thence southwesterly in an imaginary straight line to the peak of Kitubod Range,
point (4); thence continue in the same direction in an imaginary straight line to the center of Malitubog River,
the common boundary of Carmen and Libungan municipalities, point (5); thence northerly following the
upstream course of Malitubog River to its intersection with Cotabato Lanao del Sur provincial boundary, to
point of origin."
